title: uf/{head_id}/label payload
description: UPSERT payload of uf/{head_id}/label: the name a figure is shown under when the catalogue has no product for its head (a figure the user holds that no store lists: an unlicensed resin, a custom piece). The writer mints the head. Shown only while the head has no card; a card always wins and the label is kept, hidden. Serialized, at most 3,300 bytes of UTF-8 as JSON.stringify writes it, under the Push cap MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES (65,536).

name.description: 1 to 200 Unicode code points: the figure's title as the user knows it. Private to the user: never logged.

maker.description: 1 to 100 Unicode code points: the manufacturer or studio. Omit it rather than send an empty one.

series.description: 1 to 100 Unicode code points: the series or franchise. Omit it rather than send an empty one.

scale.description: 1 to 20 Unicode code points: the scale as the card writes it, e.g. 1/6. Omit it rather than send an empty one.

edition.description: 1 to 100 Unicode code points: the version, edition or variant, e.g. Luxury ver. Omit it rather than send an empty one.

edited_at.description: When the user made the edit, in the device's local time with its offset (at most ±18:00). Display only; never compared, never restamped.

tz.description: The device's IANA time zone at edit time, e.g. America/Chicago. Display only.
